items.name: Summarize Skill
items.description: AI skill that summarizes any text or webpage concisely
items.longDescription:
Adds a 'summarize' capability to the AI agent. Can summarize articles, web pages, documents, and chat conversations.

Usage: 'Summarize this page' or 'Summarize the last conversation'

- Extracts key points
- Adjustable length (short/medium/long)
- Works with web pages and text
items.author: maxnebula
items.instructions: Summary skill configuration for AI agent. Enable in Dashboard > Capabilities.

items.name: Translate Skill
items.description: AI skill that translates text between 50+ languages
items.longDescription:
Adds translation capability to the AI agent. Supports 50+ languages with automatic language detection.

Usage: 'Translate this to Spanish' or 'What does bonjour mean?'

- 50+ languages supported
- Auto language detection
- Maintains formatting
- Natural translations
items.author: maxnebula
items.instructions: Translation skill configuration for AI agent. Enable in Dashboard > Capabilities.
